from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One financial report containing the specific profit metric data."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as reported")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by this report (e.g., '2017 Q3', '2019 Q1')")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The financial metric being reported")
    single_quarter_value: float | None = Field(description="The single-quarter value for this period, if provided")
    single_quarter_yoy_change: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year change percentage for the single quarter, if provided")
    ytd_value: float | None = Field(description="Year-to-date cumulative value, if provided in the report")
    ytd_yoy_change: float | None = Field(description="Year-over-year change percentage for YTD, if provided")
    report_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of this report")
    report_quarter: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal quarter number (1-4), if determinable")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
